name: metro-station-designer
description: Root tooling for the Station Designer concept-art site. The site itself lives in web/ and is deployed to Cloudflare Workers as static assets.

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:game && npm run setup:model
scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build:game: npm --prefix game ci && npm --prefix game run build
scripts.deploy:game: npm run build:game && wrangler deploy -c game/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.bench:browser: npm --prefix game run build && node tools/bench-browser.mjs
